description: Pull genotype calls for a germplasm × variant set. Filter to bound cost — at minimum, set `variantSetDbId` or `germplasmDbIds`. The upstream pull is capped by deployment policy; when the pull is truncated, narrow the filters or query the spilled dataframe. `loadLimit` bounds the rows returned inline; the full collected set is materialized as a dataframe — query it with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL) instead of paging row-by-row.

alias.description: Connection alias registered via brapi_connect. Omit to read the connection registered under alias `default` — i.e. a prior brapi_connect call that did not specify an alias. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

callFormat.description: Requested call-encoding format, when the server honors it.

callSetDbIds.description: Restrict to these call sets directly.

loadLimit.description: Cap on rows returned inline. Omit for the deployment default. When the collected set exceeds this, the full result lands in a dataframe and only the first `loadLimit` rows return inline — query the dataframe with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL) for the rest. Upstream pageSize is fixed for genotype calls, so this knob only affects the inline preview here (no spillover capacity tradeoff).

variantSetDbId.description: Scope calls to a single variant set. Strongly recommended.

variantSetDbIds.description: Alternative: multiple variant sets at once.

name: brapi_find_genotype_calls

alias.description: Alias of the registered BrAPI connection the call used.

appliedFilters.description: The body sent to POST /search/calls (variant/germplasm/call-set scope plus pageSize).

callFormatting.description: Genotype-encoding hints echoed by the server.

expandHomozygotes.description: When true, homozygous calls are expanded to both alleles.

unknownString.description: String used for unknown / missing calls (often "." or "N").

dataframe.description: Dataframe handle when the full collected calls exceed loadLimit and were materialized as a dataframe. Query it with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL).

columnLegend.description: Maps a sanitized column name back to its original upstream key, for columns renamed to clear the SQL-safe-identifier gate (e.g. `end` → `end_`). Present only when a column was renamed — write SQL against the sanitized (left-hand) names.

columns.description: Full column list of the dataframe.

items.description: Column name from the materialized rows.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the dataframe was created.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the dataframe metadata will be purged. Re-run the find_* tool to refresh, or copy results out before expiry.

maxRows.description: Cap that was applied at create time, when truncation occurred.

rowCount.description: Number of rows materialized in the dataframe.

tableName.description: Dataframe name. Use with brapi_dataframe_describe (schema + provenance) and brapi_dataframe_query (SQL).

totalCount.description: Total rows reported by the upstream server (may exceed rowCount when truncated).

truncated.description: True when the dataframe hit a row cap before exhausting upstream.

distributions.description: Value frequency per field across the full collected call set.

callSetName.description: Call set name → count of calls from that set.

variantName.description: Variant name → count of calls for that variant.

variantSetDbId.description: Variant set ID → count of calls from that set.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_alias`: No connection has been registered under the requested alias. `no_filters`: No variant set, germplasm, call set, or variant filter was provided. `search_endpoint_disabled`: The active dialect declares POST /search/calls as known-dead on this server. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True when the collection was truncated (equivalent to `truncated`).

notice.description: Guidance when no calls were returned — how to broaden filters or verify IDs.

results.description: Call rows returned in-context (up to loadLimit).

callSetDbId.description: FK to the call set (one germplasm × one variant set = one call set).

callSetName.description: Display name of the call set.

values.description: Encoded allele values — interpret using top-level `callFormatting`.

genotype.description: Structured genotype payload (array of allele values plus server-specific fields).

genotypeValue.description: Legacy flat string form of the call (provided by some servers instead of `genotype`).

phaseSet.description: Phase-set identifier linking calls that share a haplotype phase.

variantDbId.description: FK to the variant being called.

variantName.description: Display name / alias of the variant.

variantSetDbId.description: FK to the variant set the call belongs to.

returnedCount.description: Length of results[] — rows returned in-context (up to loadLimit).

totalCount.description: Total calls collected across all pages (may be capped by the deployment-wide pull limit; check `truncated`).

truncated.description: True when the deployment-wide pull limit was reached and more calls exist upstream. Narrow the filters and re-pull, or query the spilled dataframe.

warnings.description: Advisory messages (truncation, capability gaps, partial pulls).
